prompt:
Gemini Image Prompt

Create exactly one 9:16 image: a low-angle wide illustration on a rocky deep-sea benthic floor, with a giant isopod dominating the foreground as it crawls slowly toward camera, its broad overlapping segmented armor plates, jointed legs, antennae, and pill-bug-like body shape immediately readable and biologically grounded. In the rear-left, small for scale, the Red Horned Everyman crouches at a respectful distance studying it with restrained, skeptical curiosity: slim lanky red-skinned adult, exactly two enormous symmetrical black ridged horns sweeping upward/outward, pointed ears, long angular nose, tired drooping eyes, short tousled black hair, pointed black goatee, two small lower tusks, plaid overshirt, dark shirt, faded jeans, worn work boots; preserve horn headroom, no extra fantasy traits. Render everything in the established abyssal monochrome illustration world: bone-white matte paper with faint natural tooth, clean rounded carbon-black monoline contours, simplified anatomy, sparse graphite-gray micro-accents, minimal hatching only for essential depth, flat diffuse illustrative lighting, generous negative space, tiny marine particulate/bubble/current marks, and only an extremely sparse cyan accent if useful for one key adaptation. Maintain the recurring thin hand-drawn outer contour and organic interlocking illustration-window language, using the full height naturally with no caption reserve or blank lower strip. Reference roles: character_sheet = host identity only, never pose/layout; style_reference = broad visual compatibility only; world_keyframe = established world rendering and frame-language continuity; operator_style_reference = line-art/editorial qualities only, never its people, objects, text, logos, or composition; previous_beat = binding for material/edge treatment, inner window, texture, palette, lighting, and full-height layout, but never copy its camera, crop, pose, placement, focal object, or composition. No photorealism, 3D CGI, anime, painterly effects, horror, storyboard, grid, collage, panels, captions, labels, UI, or readable text.

Clarify the isopod's foreground crawl direction NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a consistent clean off-white matte field bounded by a thin hand-drawn black contour near the outer edge, occasionally interrupted by tiny bubble, current, or plankton marks; each scene sits inside an organically interlocking line-art illustration window rather than a rigid panel, with generous white breathing channels separating creature silhouettes. The same thin contour weight, rounded corners, scattered miniature ocean marks, and open negative-space rhythm repeat across every body image. The lower edge transitions naturally into a quieter low-detail field rather than a hard caption box.. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
